call_points.text: Management aspires to an 8% operating margin for FY27, with Q1 at 7.3%.
Expects 20%+ volume growth for FY27, with low base for most of the next nine months.
Hopes to surpass FY25 earnings this year if second-half sales are good.
Compressor line at Supa targets mass production by December-January; second 2 million line decision possible in April-May.
FY27 capex is about ₹400 Cr, focused on completing compressor and refrigerator projects.
RAC industry primary sales grew 15% in Q1, with 10-12% ASP increase; secondary sales better than primary.
RAC outsourcing percentage is rising, and brands are increasingly outsourcing to conserve margins.
Gross margin softened on higher copper and aluminium prices and rupee depreciation; per-unit margin stable.
Company is net cash with ₹491.3 Cr cash and bank balance and modest debt.
Inventory remains above ₹1,000 Cr due to high commodity prices and strategic stocking ahead of import restrictions.
Management declined to quantify capex split or margin impact from resin costs, citing competitive sensitivity.
Targeting better-than-industry revenue growth and EBITDA margins improving towards 8% in FY27.
Rotary compressor plant at Supa to begin install in Aug 2026 with 2 mn capacity starting Q4FY27.
Commodity inflation and INR depreciation caused a 250 bps gross margin hit in Q4FY26.
Forex loss was ₹38.77 Cr in FY26 against a gain of ₹17.99 Cr in FY25.
Total inventory of ₹1,601 Cr at FY26 end targeted to decline below ₹900 Cr by June end.
LPG shortage and truck availability in March caused an aggregate revenue loss of ₹420 Cr.
Order book for product business remains robust with expectations of strong growth in FY27.
Product business crossed ₹4,000 Cr in FY26, growing 14.3% YoY and forming 76.2% of revenue.
FY26 operating margins were pressured by cost inflation and higher commodity prices.
Room AC business grew 9.3% YoY to ₹3,288 Cr while Washing Machines grew 51.5% YoY in FY26.
Capex reached ₹785 Cr in FY26 while cash and equivalents stood at ₹389 Cr.
